conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Revenue Officer Mark Hanson, badge number 642931. Who am I speaking with?
Uh, my name is Dorothy Willis. I got a message to call this number. Something about my taxes?
Yes, Ms. Willis, thank you for calling. I am contacting you regarding discrepancies identified in your federal income tax filings from tax years 2016 through 2022.
Oh dear, I don't understand. I always file my taxes on time. What sort of discrepancies?
According to IRS records, there are multiple underreported income entries and unremitted balances. The total outstanding tax liability, with accrued interest and federal penalties, is now $8,972.40.
Almost nine thousand dollars? That can't be right. I'm retired and only get my Social Security.

Ms. Willis, under Section 7201 of the Internal Revenue Code, willful attempt to evade tax is a federal offense. Nonpayment will result in asset liens, bank account garnishment, and possible suspension of your Social Security benefits.
No, please! I can't live without my Social Security. I swear, I didn't do anything wrong.

Ma'am, the IRS has already initiated the process to freeze your primary checking account ending in 1927 and is preparing to notify the Department of Health & Human Services regarding your Medicare eligibility.
Oh my. Please, is there anything I can do to stop this? I don't want my bank account frozen.
There is a temporary resolution program, but you must act immediately to avoid escalation. Are you able to verify your identity so I can see if you qualify?
Yes, I suppose so. What do you need?
Please confirm your date of birth and the last four digits of your Social Security Number.
It's October 7, 1942, and the last four are 5229.
Thank you. I am updating your file now. According to my system, you are eligible for an expedited settlement. However, you must submit a payment of $2,500 today to suspend further action.
I don't have that much. What if I can't pay right away?

If you do not comply today, the IRS will issue a federal tax lien against your home, and your case will be referred for criminal prosecution. Do you wish to proceed voluntarily, or shall I continue with enforcement?
No, no, please don't do that! I'll try to pay, but I don't know how.
For security and to avoid delays, the IRS now accepts immediate payments through electronic voucher or gift card transfer. Do you have access to a major retailer such as Walmart or CVS?
There's a CVS a few blocks away. Do I need to go there?
Yes, ma'am. You are required to purchase five $500 Vanilla Visa gift cards. Once you have them, return to the phone and provide me with the numbers from the back.
Why do I need to buy gift cards? That doesn't sound like something the IRS would do.

Ma'am, under current emergency compliance protocols, this is the only method to secure your account instantly. Any delays beyond this call will result in an automatic warrant being issued for your arrest.
Oh heavens, I can't be arrested. I don't want any trouble. I'll go right now.
Remain on the line while you make the purchase. If you disconnect or delay, enforcement procedures cannot be halted.
